philippines.title: Last victim of South Cotabato school shooting laid to rest
philippines.description:
KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — A month after the deadly shooting at Banga National High School in South Cotabato, the last of the three students who died in the incident was laid to rest on Saturday, Oct. 17, as grieving relatives renewed their call for justice. Angelito Perra, 14, who was shot in the back during the attack carried out by a fellow student, was buried at the Banga Public Cemetery following a funeral Mass held before noon. Hundreds of mourners, including relatives, friends, classmates, teachers, and officials from the Department of Education and the local government, joined the burial rites. […]...

philippines.title: CESAFI: Benedicto College Cheetahs prevail in grinding rematch vs. UC Webmasters
philippines.description:
CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs survived a late rally by the University of Cebu (UC) Webmasters to escape with a 67-64 victory in their rematch as the Cesafi Season 26 men’s basketball tournament opened its second round on Saturday, October 17, at the Cebu Coliseum. Serge Gabines led the Cheetahs with a double-double of 16 points and 10 rebounds, adding four blocks and two assists. He shot 7-of-13 from the field, delivering crucial baskets when Benedicto needed them most. philippines.title: P5.96-M ecstasy pills seized from Nigerian in Angeles City sting
philippines.description:
MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga— The police arrested a Nigerian who was allegedly in possession of ecstasy pills worth an estimated P5.96 million during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Balibago, Angeles City late Friday night. In a statement on Saturday, the Angeles City police said the 46-year-old Nigerian national is on the list of “high-value individuals” under the government’s campaign against illegal drugs. It said combined operatives from the Angeles City police and regional police units conducted the buy-bust along 1st Street in Barangay Balibago around 10:30 p.m. Using marked peso bills, an undercover police officer bought a few ecstasy tablets from the […]...
